records.name: Pillard
records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Project RL native roguelike sprite review. Original brutal industrial futuristic setting. Match the already accepted Project RL tile references for readability and chunky pixel style.
Primary request: ONE character design with its standing/active form and collapsed inactive/dead form. Make a TRANSPARENT PNG with exactly TWO equally sized square panels side by side, total composition 2:1. LEFT is the complete living/active form, RIGHT is the SAME identity newly drawn collapsed horizontally, not a rotated standing pose. A small dark burgundy/red fluid pool sits directly underneath the corpse/wreck only. Machines leak red coolant; organic forms have blood. No organs.
Style: actual coarse 32x32 logical pixel grid per panel displayed at a large INTEGER zoom, crisp solid square pixels, 1 logical pixel near-black contour, large simple connected color clusters, 12-20 useful colors, two shades per material, upper-left lighting. Full subject readable at 32 pixels, 1 pixel transparent margin. Living humanoids about30 pixels tall. Corpse/wreck 26-30 pixels wide and only12-16 pixels high at bottom. Exact two panels, no overlap.
Constraints: TWO substantial color regions, fixed coherent anatomy across living and dead, preserve expected support count, thick readable joints. No decorative detailing, micro-lines, gradients, dither, rust-speckle noise, shine, texture parasites, additional tiny props, floating weapon, ground shadow, halo, effects, checkerboard, background, scenery, labels, text, numbers or borders. Keep all empty areas truly alpha transparent. Do not copy any reference creature; refs only define pixel size, style and human-relative scale.
Input images: Image1 edit target is the original Pillard living/dead pair. Image2 only scale/style reference. Replace medieval clothing in BOTH panels with futuristic industrial outfit; preserve a recognizably human biped, its height and the paired living/corpse structure. The hood is expressly rejected and must be removed. Helmet/respirator must look industrial, boots modern, no cloak or robe.

Subject #9, proposed name "Pillard": Near-front human scavenger in a solid industrial teal helmet and amber respirator, broad amber work jacket over teal armored vest, navy work trousers and steel-toed boots. Two ordinary human arms and two legs, matching the current human player height. Hold ONE short heavy steel impact baton in the right hand, straight shaft, thick blunt end, absolutely no sword guard. Left hand empty. Thick utility belt, only one broad chest pocket. NO hood, cloak, robe, medieval helmet, leather jerkin or fantasy ornament. Both living feet/supports and dead body stay within their own square panel, without stretching limbs.
RIGHT panel retains exact same colors, head and support count, with visibly folded/collapsed anatomy and a small dark red pool.
